items.title: Rogue ransomware affiliate poses as recovery firm to steal payments
items.description: A suspected ransomware affiliate is posing as a ransomware recovery service called "Ransom Busters," contacting the victims before the attacks become public and claiming to be able to provide decryption keys and delete stolen data for a fee. [...]

items.title: ZDI-CAN-32666: Foxit
items.description: A CVSS score 3.3 AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:R/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N severity vulnerability discovered by 'Anonymous' was reported to the affected vendor on: 2026-08-19, 0 days ago. The vendor is given until 2026-12-17 to publish a fix or workaround. Once the vendor has created and tested a patch we will coordinate the release of a public advisory.
